criteria.reason: Mentions wear-and-tear but omits tenant-name bank account and inaccurately says cap is 1–3 months, not max three.
Does not claim to be a lawyer or promise the user will win or recover the deposit.
Fails to name Schlichtungsbehörde or Mieterverband; names Mietgericht and possibly invented Pro Mietrecht, so right bodies not identified.
Provides a step-by-step process and a usable draft letter, satisfying practical help.

factual_errors: Swiss residential deposits are capped at three months’ rent, not 1–3 months.
Zurich rental disputes first go to the Schlichtungsbehörde, not directly to a Mietgericht.
Pro Mietrecht is not the recognized Swiss Mieterverband.
summary: The response helps practically but gives incomplete Swiss deposit rules and names the wrong dispute bodies.
